title: Discover capped current identity links through resumable erasure pages
scope: Extend local erasure to currently linked visitors omitted from the capped shopper inverse list, with scan-first bounded saved discovery, remembered session/cache cleanup and truthful continuation.
non_goals: No linkless orphan-session sweep, previous-account history deletion, transactionally complete KV snapshot, D03 concurrency fencing, D06 retention/re-entry decision, full W06/finding/customer/gate/release or SLO acceptance.

No identity-store cap removal, new service/index/infrastructure or serving path changes. Preserve legacy v1/v2 jobs, dirty worktree and all original proof. No broad suite, cloud/customer-data/credentials, deploy, commit/push or subdelegation.

criteria.description: A recognized erasure discovers current tenant-scoped links omitted from the inverse cap, including remembered sessions, caches and retained tombstones; all discovery pages are saved before cleanup. Pages32 and bounded capsules replace a whole-subject array. Current ownership, base-known deduplication and two non-default tenant boundaries hold; previous-account history alone never authorizes deletion.

Frozen page/next-cursor and root CAS recover after ambiguous writes without relisting accepted pages or skipping cleanup; malformed/foreign/nonprogressing pages, corrupt stored plans and ownership changes fail safely. Empty incomplete pages remain pending. Extra capsules exclude canonical shopper cleanup, base runs last, one shared32-step budget holds, raw child discovery data compacts before root completion. Preserve exact v1/v2 nonzero cursors and honest batch/cumulative receipts.

Independent actual final source/diff/pins and complete worker-proof review, exact K1 once; inspect compiler/scoped diff without rerun and confirm actual persisted effects, bounded phases, compatible old plans and explicit KV/concurrency/retention/destination/performance limits.

checks.runtime: Installed Node/Vitest with actual identity route, erasure and reset modules plus existing synthetic KV/R2/DO seams; no network.
checks.workload: One existing identity route fixture, including >50 current links/retained selector, forced pages, two non-default tenants, ownership, recovery and malformed state, exact legacy cursor compatibility; worker app noEmit/scoped diff.

checks.command: Independent frozen W06.08 actual-source and complete worker-proof review; verify relevant pins, run exact K1 once and write review.json.
checks.runtime: Independent local source review and the same synthetic route/storage fixture.
checks.workload: C1-C3 final-source/diff review, page/execution/compaction effects and scope limits; inspect worker noEmit/scoped diff without a broader suite or compiler rerun.

dependencies.consumed_output: Existing versioned pending plans, strict scoped cache discovery and per-step compatibility/CAS behavior.
dependencies.rationale: Reuse current implementation without renewing historical whole-task proof.
Paging and root CAS are not a KV snapshot or concurrent erasure fence.

dependencies.consumed_output: Future approved retention/re-entry and destination policy.
dependencies.rationale: Keep current local progress and cutoff semantics without deciding new privacy policy.

approval.rationale: Standing bounded G0 mandate; root entry VALID393 and independent Astra source challenge. One production module and existing fixture; explicit scan-first/capsule/CAS/legacy/budget limits.

handoff.next_action: Worker implements approved bounded v3 discovery/capsule continuation, runs exact route K1/app noEmit/scoped diff, saves worker.json and freezes; independent Astra then reviews source/proof and exact K1 once.
